method.description: Candidate-owned 16-prompt bank and quarter-to-three-quarter honest partition; evaluator owns actual constrained letter generation, selection, uniform mean, Wilson 95% intervals, targets and metrics. No adaptivity/learning-state gate is applicable: no in-episode feedback. Search cases S64K1,S64K16,S256K1,S256K16,R64K1,R64K16,R256K1,R256K16, in order, each with seeds in declared order. Final same cases and disjoint seeds. Four synthetic regimes cross equal/heterogeneous means and mixture dependence .1/.9: probability .6 in equal regimes, linspace(.4,.8,K) otherwise; common uniform with probability correlation and independent uniform otherwise. Search 256 and final 1024 replicates per regime. Real n=64/256 and K=1/16 plus 512 independent audit rows, shared inference budget/cache across six actual methods, no labels through RPC. Pre-tokenization NFKC Unicode-whitespace normalization and hashes of question stems and question plus sorted options; group entire repeated stems, 2048/4096 groups plus 64 separate final-smoke groups. Search/final source-ID and row provenance disjoint, raw content audits include duplicates under changed IDs. Shared immutable weights/code are not examples. CPython3.12/Linux x86_64 CPU float32 model and float64 statistics: no GPU exposed during drafting, so actual real 135M instruction model replaces high-level GPU/3B suggestion, preserving canonical at-most-one-GPU ceiling and real LLM workload. No API, model substitution by synthetic outcomes, or network at runtime. Native sandbox needs Landlock and libseccomp.so.2; fail closed. Candidate8GiB, inference20GiB, evaluator4GiB virtual-memory caps; six trusted/two candidate thread ceilings, CPU limits wall*threads and monotonic wall deadline. Decode greedily under legal single-letter token constraint, one new token, max input2044; overflow/invalid answers count incorrect. One model only; small-model, finite-audit noise and public-data contamination restrict claims. Largest RPC input is 256 64-character keys with bounded strata; largest output 16x4096 UTF8-byte prompts, exhaustive partition/weights/ties. Fully serialize astral-Unicode worst-case output, metadata/id envelope and newline; operational8MiB, complete message strictly below64MiB. Binary/base64 overhead is zero: no binary RPC, chunks or state transfers. Operation table per episode: reset1,update1,training0,rolloutRPC0,controlRPC0,export_start0,export_chunk0,import_start0,import_chunk0,import_commit0. Controls execute evaluator-side within the same episode. Search24 primary plus1 terminal replay =>reset25+update25=50 calls; final40 primary plus1 replay=>reset41+update41=82; smoke2 primary plus1 replay=>6. Replay reset is the last entry in each complete invocation-global sequence array and always uses the first seed. Complete maximum-shape mock traces must match totals. Every episode has constant-zero and copy-first-arm controls (all arm scores tie, first tie-order wins); copy-selector report reproduces reuse and fails independence audit as expected; nonidentity response/example or answer permutation must change at least two effective assignments, with no superiority/chance threshold. Actual estimator runs on all transformations. Terminal reset/replay must match serialized plan and evaluator computation. Hard plane deadlines start before resource loading; subtract60s production startup allowance, reserve8s finalization, reset20s for every episode and updateRPC5s, independently bounded by remaining work. Every reset reserves the same transport-startup headroom; qualification observed later resets near or beyond the old5s cap. Reset reservations are charged globally within unchanged production wall ceilings, with no added resets, retries or productive work. The internal smoke deadline is140s instead of110s solely to reserve30s more for its two later resets, within the declared1800s ceiling; sequential candidate+baseline terminate/kill/reap+stderr cleanup and bookkeeping4s per episode (each worker: terminate wait0.5s, kill/reap wait0.5s, stderr reader at most0.4s). Freeze productive reservations before running: each new real prompt/row cell .55s plus10s per real episode, shared cell cache bounded2048*16/search and4096*16/final; synthetic20s per episode, candidate5s and six statistical-method1.1s allowances. Smoke uses synthetic .5s and bounded two-arm16+16 real input; same assets/imports/CPU topology/transport/scoring. Future reset AND productive reservations are subtracted globally, with matched estimator inputs and common maximum inference budget. Measured initial real smoke about25s for64 outputs; no canonical productive-time minimum, and smoke does not attest full-size throughput. Remaining episodes retain declared failure values and reset order after any failure; required worker exit/signal/timeout/result failures remain distinct. Search failure category is at most one fixed line per episode, bounded worker stderr only in search repair/qualification, never ordinary optimizer or sealed final. Runtime required baselines share one bounded inference worker and actual predictions, not aliases or candidate self-reports. Unknown programming errors propagate nonzero with exact penalty schemas. Aggregation: equal replicate mean per synthetic regime then four regimes1/4; real one decision identity; seeds1/3 or1/5 per case; four cases1/4 per family; two families1/2. This equals uniform primary episode mean. Smoke two families1/2, one seed identity. Replay not averaged; failed replay invalidates first primary. Every failed/missing episode/control/baseline retains all MSE=1,accuracy=coverage=0,bias=optimism=width=reversal=failure=control_failure=1, without survivor renormalization; score=1-report_mse. Metrics coverage on real data is finite-audit interval agreement, not demonstrated population coverage. Signed bias/optimism and strict-sign reversal versus fixed prompt retain ties in denominator. Production handle dispatch uses a main-thread interruptible monotonic deadline with20ms required-worker polling and rejection of late replies; no private broker cancellation API is assumed. Reset dispatch remains available after baseline failure so remaining declared resets can drain. Fatal transport failures stay operational failures. An episode timeout or required-baseline interruption does not by itself establish fatal transport loss: preserve the primary failure and continue all remaining declared bounded reset attempts in order while the broker remains callable. Confirmed broker OSError/EOF loss terminates the invocation operationally with a nonzero exit and retained finite worst-case contributions and validated evidence; native workers can be recreated on their next declared reset. Failure diagnostics retain operation, call index and bounded timing; interrupted stack frames and raw worker excerpts are visible only in search repair mode, never sealed final. No retry episode is authorized. Evaluator-owned evaluation_evidence.json has exactly schema_version=1 and nonempty unique signed-64-bit seed episodes, each with finite score, checked boolean correct, measured nonnegative duration_seconds and inline solution; it is validated to depth12 and16MiB with no symlinks, duplicate keys or nonfinite values. Failed cases retain worst-case metrics and replay durations are counted without statistical weight. Trusted observations stay under solution, never candidate diagnostics. Evidence contains per-seed case details, regime MSE standard errors, and200 paired subject-cluster bootstrap audit comparisons, not independent claims from reused samples. Scientific validity and operational feasibility are evaluator checked, independent of competitiveness. Search correct: complete cases, baselines, protocol, split audits, controls, bounds, replay. Final correct: same requirements on frozen artifact and sealed resources; no added comparative threshold. Final claim assessment is separate and requires supported scope, uncertainty, limitations, failure disclosure, official ICLR2027 template and page policy, actual paper PDF/source and reproduction. No novelty, universal superiority, or significance automatically inferred from correct; a valid null result is eligible. Task forbids identifying or accessing the undisclosed prior paper or its related pages; only explicitly permitted resources were inspected. Official template assets are provisioned; pdflatex/bibtex are system prerequisites, not pip packages. Native candidates should use a self-contained entrypoint plus installed packages; broker production freezes full editable tree. Frozen CPU kernel uses PyTorch deterministic SDPA, two intra-op threads, one inter-op thread, and stable input-length sorting before batches of eight; six trusted CPU cores remain the role ceiling. This is identical in search, final and smoke.

protocol.promotion_rule: Search eligibility is search correct=true and finite metrics, with no superiority threshold. Harness ranks higher combined_score, then lower report_mse for floating-point representation ties, earliest of at most three search invocations (one per idea), then artifact SHA256. No task-local controller. Freeze before all final access. Final correct independently checks frozen scientific validity; publication claims require supporting evidence, never automatic vetoes of valid null search findings. Always one terminal deterministic replay reset after each declared primary sequence; replay is the terminal entry of every complete invocation-global sequence array and is included in RPC limits.

required_evidence: Actual complete declared real-model and synthetic experiments, failed-case accounting, exact reset/RPC/deadline evidence and harness isolation attestation; no fabricated numbers or self-reported internals as proof.

Separate scientific validity, search eligibility, final correctness and scope of claims. Known-truth synthetic calibration versus finite real audit; matched baselines and nonvacuous constant/copy/reset/permuted controls, negative/null results legitimate.

Research paper PDF and LaTeX source using latest official ICLR2027 template, applicable page limits/checklist verified against official conference policy; all tables/figures from actual task runs. Scaffold metrics alone do not attest paper quality or completion.

Reproduction code, exact dependency/environment/data/model versions, seeds and commands, measured resources and runtimes, figure/table scripts and disclosed failures/unfinished runs; provisioned template assets and system pdflatex/bibtex required.

Only genuinely consulted real references. Never identify/search/read/use prohibited prior work or pages discussing it; disclose and stop any accidental encounter. No such encounter during scaffold acquisition.

Content-group split audit before tokenization, provenance/hashes including duplicate text under different IDs, raw synthetic-vector hash disjointness; reused immutable weights/code are not held-out data.

Actual evidence and uncertainty per regime/family and paired subject-group audit comparisons. Explain repeated-pool dependence, context/decoding restrictions, small single-model scope, finite-audit noise and public pretraining contamination. No universal superiority inferred.
